issues.issue: Whether the claimant's account of the 2009 attack is credible and linked to corrupt officials
issues.applicant_position: Attackers were corrupt officials she helped convict and they sought revenge.
issues.result_text: Panel rejects the collusion explanation and finds her testimony about statements heard not credible.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces persecution or personal risk from her husband or the attackers
issues.applicant_position: Ex-husband and former soldiers threaten her; husband made telephone threats.
issues.result_text: No serious possibility of persecution or personal risk in Rwanda under sections 96 or 97.

issues.applicant_position: Attackers were never identified; police did not give effective protection.
issues.result_text: Police intervened effectively several times; presumption of adequate state protection not rebutted.

issues.issue: Whether the Chairperson's gender guideline changes the outcome
issues.result_text: The gender guideline does not change the facts or the conclusion.

issues.issue: Whether the children's refugee claims succeed
issues.result_text: Children's claims are derived from the mother's and rejected on the same grounds.

issues.issue: Whether the co-claimant is a Convention refugee or person in need of protection
issues.applicant_position: Threatened by half-sister's husband after separation; same facts as half-sister.
issues.result_text: Co-claimant is not a Convention refugee or person in need of protection; claim rejected.
